Article III.REAR YARD EASEMENT
Section 3.01 Developer hereby grants, transfers, and conveys to Owner, for the
benefit of Townhouse Property, a perpetual easement (the “Rear Yard Easement") in
and over a portion of Developer's Property (the “Easement Area") as described in the
metes and bounds description set forth in Exhibit B and the sketch map set forth in
Exhibit B-1 attached hereto. Developer covenants and agrees that no buildings,
improvements, alterations or additions shall be constructed or allowed to exist on
Developer's Land that encroach upon the Easement Area.
Section 3.02 Developer shall be permitted to place in the Easement Area only
those items that are listed as "Permitted Obstructions in Required Yards or Rear Yard
Equivalents" in Section 23-44 of the Zoning Resolution, as the same may be amended.
Section 3.03 Developer agrees to maintain the Easement Area in a clean and
sanitary condition, free of odorous materials.
Section 3.04 This Rear Yard Easement is given solely for the benefit of Owner,
its successors, and assigns.
